mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: dotelecmd() for the extended command 'teleport' is not ported

summary: The C-first recording reaches the #teleport extended command after levelporting to the Sanctum. cmd.c registers that row with dotelecmd; JavaScript extended-command dispatch falls through to its unsupported-handler boundary at cmd.js:5370, even though the direct key branch has separate inline teleport logic. Port the complete contiguous teleport.c:dotelecmd()/dotele() family into js/teleport.js and route both command dispatch and the active drowning caller through the canonical owner. The recorded C path is wizard controlled teleport: dotelecmd() calls dotele(TRUE), next_to_u() succeeds, and tele() calls scrolltele(NULL) to print the destination prompt at step 30.

source.branch: Wizard human in debug mode invokes the #teleport extended command from the Sanctum without a teleport trap at the hero square. C dispatches cmd.c:1890-1891 to dotelecmd(); absent menu prefix, dotelecmd sets ignore_restrictions and calls dotele(TRUE). The hero is adjacent to a valid square, so dotele calls tele(), which calls scrolltele(NULL) and opens the controlled destination selector. The full family must also preserve nonwizard dotele(FALSE), menu modes, visible trap prompts, restriction/spell/energy checks, and the second next_to_u() check.
functions: teleport.c:dotelecmd() (919-1031), complete wizard/nonwizard command handler and temporary teleport-away spell save/restore.
teleport.c:dotele() (1033-1162), complete trap, restriction, spell-energy, relocation, and hunger decision tree.
callers: cmd.c:1890-1891 registers dotelecmd as the C(t) command and the teleport extended command. Invoke canonical js/teleport.js:dotelecmd() from direct command-key and extended-command dispatch paths in js/cmd.js.
teleport.c:dotelecmd() calls dotele() and consumes its integer result to produce ECMD_TIME or ECMD_OK.
trap.c:drown() (5130-5132) calls dotele(FALSE) and discards its result. Active js/trap.js:drown() currently duplicates teleport eligibility/effect logic; route it through js/teleport.js:dotele().

dig.c:escape_tomb() (2241-2248) calls dotele(FALSE) and discards its result. No JavaScript escape_tomb() implementation or active JS caller exists in js/dig.js, so this is an absent caller path rather than scope for this teleport.c port.
dependencies: dotelecmd() consumes dotele() return values; dotele() is therefore included in this source task.

dotelecmd() consumes spell.c:tport_spell() results to reverse temporary spellbook addition/hiding. js/spell.js:tport_spell() is already source-mapped and present; do not reimplement it absent a missing-branch finding.

dotele() consumes next_to_u() booleans and spelleffects() ECMD results from existing js/apply_next_to_u.js and js/spell.js owners. It calls tele(), teleds(), vault_tele(), deltrap(), newsym(), exercise(), and morehungry() with results discarded; those JavaScript source adapters exist.

C dotele() calls level_tele_trap() with a discarded void result for an accepted visible level teleporter. No JS owner exists. Use note_unported('teleport.c level_tele_trap') and skip this call rather than throwing or inventing effects.
dig.c:escape_tomb() has no current JavaScript counterpart; a future dig.c port must wire it to exported dotele().
